label: Formulated and introduced Disciplinary Power & The Panopticon
description: Michel Foucault formulated and introduced the concept of "Disciplinary Power & The Panopticon", which became a seminal contribution in political philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in political.
historicalContext: Introduced during the Contemporary & Post-Structural as part of Michel Foucault's canonical writings.

label: Critiqued Foucault's model of disciplinary power in Forget Foucault (1977), arguing power itself has become simulated
description: Jean Baudrillard engaged in a direct critique of Michel Foucault's foundational principles, rejecting core axioms in favor of a dialectically opposed framework.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Michel Foucault's perspective to Jean Baudrillard's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Direct contemporaneous dialogue and pedagogical transmission during the Contemporary & Post-Structural era.
